must_find.summary: compile_path() is shared by Route/Mount/WebSocketRoute paths and Host patterns, but the new `.split(":")[0]` at after/starlette/routing.py:149 is applied unconditionally, so every path's trailing literal is truncated at the first colon. `Route("/users/{username}:disable")` compiles to `^/users/(?P<username>[^/]+)$` (matches `/users/tom` and captures username='tom:disable' for `/users/tom:disable`), and `Route("/users:batch")` compiles to `^/users$`. The port stripping must only apply to host patterns (paths start with '/').

source.fix_url_or_issue: https://github.com/encode/starlette/pull/1675 (Fix regression on route names with colons; introduced by https://github.com/encode/starlette/pull/1322)
